scenarios.title: US bank transfer
rails: US bank rail: pay-ins and payouts, run under Nacha rules
US real-time payments network operated by The Clearing House
US instant payments, operated by the Federal Reserve
scenarios.rails_note: These are alternatives, not legs of one transfer. Each rail prices differently, and your provider decides eligibility.
authorities: Anti-money-laundering authority under the Bank Secrecy Act
questions: Where the fee becomes a loss
Compare processing cost with returns, exceptions and the operational effort behind them.
Who can use the route
Ask your provider about eligibility, limits and access. A listing is not approval.
Who owns the exception

scenarios.title: US card acceptance
rails: Regulation II stops issuers and networks limiting debit to fewer than two unaffiliated networks, or blocking the merchant's routing choice
Turn on network tokens and account updater for stored cards
Route on all-in cost per approved order, with failover tested
scenarios.rails_note: Options to investigate, not a recommendation. Which debit networks a card carries is set by the issuer.
authorities: Sets the EMV and EMV 3-D Secure specifications
Sets the PCI DSS card-data security standard
questions: Which downgrades you pay for
Sort the qualification report by reason code: Level 2/3 data, card-present flag, AVS, capture timing.
Who chooses the debit route
Check whether your acquirer routes debit least-cost where the rules allow, or by default.
Which declines are soft
Split soft from hard declines and price each lost sale next to the fee line.
scenarios.unknowns: Your pricing model (blended or pass-through), downgrade volume, and how your acquirer routes debit today.
sources: Site: Interchange, Acceptance and Routing fronts
status: EMVCo sets EMV 3DS. We cite no US rule that mandates SCA.

scenarios.title: UK / EU card acceptance
rails: Where approvals are won or lost under strong customer authentication
Enabled market by market across the EU
Account-to-account payment, enabled market by market
scenarios.rails_note: Authentication decides conversion. Alternatives depend on the market and your provider.
authorities: EU banking authority; PSD2 and SCA technical standards
UK banking and finance trade association
questions: Where friction costs the sale
Put authentication drop-off next to the fee line so the trade-off is priced.
Which exemptions you use
Check which SCA exemptions your provider applies, and on which flows.
Which market needs a local method
List where bank debit or open banking would replace a card, market by market.
scenarios.unknowns: Your exemption rates, issuer behaviour by market, and which local methods your provider supports.
sources: Site: United Kingdom and European Union market entries
FCA: payment services and e-money regulations
Council of the EU: PSR position at first reading, 29 Oct 2026
status: EU: SCA under PSD2, with EBA technical standards. UK: SCA under FCA rules.
Not in force. Council adopted its first-reading position on 29 Oct 2026; Parliament's second reading is pending. PSD2 still applies.

scenarios.title: Australia & NZ card acceptance
rails: Send dual-network debit via the network that costs less. The RBA expects acquirers to offer and promote it.
ANZ, CBA, NAB and Westpac report LCR take-up to the RBA
scenarios.rails_note: Options to investigate. LCR can be binary, threshold or dynamic, and your provider sets which.
authorities: Payments System Board; regulates designated card networks
Industry body; runs the CNP Fraud Mitigation Framework
NZ; regulates Mastercard and Visa interchange under the Retail Payment System Act 2022
Governs the rules for NZ's core payment systems
status: Removed from 1 Oct 2026 on eftpos, Mastercard and Visa.
Lower domestic caps from 1 Oct 2026; a cap on foreign-issued cards from 1 Apr 2027. Online and wallet LCR is under further RBA consultation.
Personal-card limits from 1 Dec 2025 (domestic) and 1 May 2026 (foreign); commercial credit limits from 22 Apr 2027.
AU: AusPayNet requires SCA once a merchant breaches its fraud threshold for consecutive quarters. NZ: not yet sourced.
questions: Is LCR on, and which kind
Check binary, threshold or dynamic routing, in person and online.
Where the surcharge used to sit
Price the acceptance cost you can no longer pass on in Australia.
Did the cut reach your fee
Compare your rate with the pass-through large acquirers must publish from 30 Jan 2027.
scenarios.unknowns: Your plan type, LCR setting, pass-through, and whether NZ surcharging rules change.
scenarios.proof: Anitha set up Braintree Australia, twice.
